 Follow Arnold Schwarzenegger & Alan Ritchson Pull Off a Naughty Heist in New Christmas Movie Trailer
 Namrata Ghosh Mon, November 2, 2026 at 3:37 PM UTC 2 min read Add Yahoo as a preferred source to see more of our stories on Google. (Photo Credit: Prime Video) Prime Video has unveiled the official trailer for Arnold Schwarzenegger and Alan Ritchson 's new Christmas movie. The upcoming action comedy follows a holiday heist to recover Santa's stolen bag.
 The Man with the Bag premieres exclusively on Prime Video on December 2, 2026. The movie is directed by Adam Shankman and written by Allan Rice. Schwarzenegger stars as Santa Claus, who recruits Vance, a thief played by Ritchson, to help him retrieve his stolen magic bag before Christmas.
 Check out The Man with the Bag trailer below ( watch more trailers ):
 What happens in The Man with the Bag trailer?
 The Man with the Bag trailer opens with Ritchson's Vance, a skilled pickpocket and thief, having a conversation with his little daughter Emma at a diner when he gets a mysterious job offer with a life-changing payout.
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement His client is a jovial man in a red suit who introduces himself as Kris and tells him that his bag was stolen. Kris warns that Christmas is at risk if he doesn't recover the bag. Kris then reveals that he is actually Santa Claus and takes Vance and his daughter on a merry ride in his flying sleigh.
 Santa tells Vance that a rogue elf with a grudge has stolen his magic bag. Santa needs Vance's help to recover it before Christmas. Vance takes the job and assembles a crew of misfits to pull off the ultimate heist.
 The trailer also offers glimpses of the film's comic and magical moments. According to the official logline, The Man with the Bag promises a "holiday heist adventure about second chances, unlikely friendships, and discovering that sometimes even Santa needs a little help delivering Christmas."
 In addition to Schwarzenegger and Ritchson, The Man with the Bag stars Awkwafina, Liza Koshy, Kyle Mooney, Adrian Martinez, Jane Krakowski, and Ken Jeong.
